description: Constant-power panner placing a polyphonic mono signal between a left and a right output

params.text: Places the signal between the two outputs, hard left at one end and hard right at the other, with both outputs at 0.71 of the input level at the centre

inputs.text: The signal to be panned; every polyphonic channel is panned and the outputs carry the same number of channels
Added to the PAN knob channel by channel; with the knob hard left, 0V to 10V here sweeps left to right, and with the knob centred, -5V to +5V does

outputs.text: The input scaled by the cosine of the pan angle, full level with the pan hard left and silent with it hard right
The input scaled by the sine of the pan angle, silent with the pan hard left and full level with it hard right

notes: with nothing patched to in, both outputs are held at 0V.
the CV jack is read channel by channel against the in jack's channel count, so a monophonic CV cable pans only the first channel and every other channel follows the knob alone.
bypassing the whole module in Rack passes in straight to the left output and leaves the right one silent.

inputs.1:
±5V · continuous · polyphonic

unpatched it reads 0V; a negative voltage subtracts from the knob; the knob and this input are summed and the total held to ±5V.
